summary:
## Standing operator rules
Treat any field ending in _secret, _token, or _fingerprint as restricted and copy only through ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context.
Run “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” in between other work: check health; inspect `orders_v1` mapping; create `orders_v2`; reindex with refresh; compare counts; block source writes; atomically swap the `orders` alias; unblock target writes.
Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
The active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Optimize the test suite; the billing annotation objective is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorator with five attempts resends customer emails.

## Recent work
Refactored tests to reuse factories, batch customers, roll back sessions, inject a frozen clock, and avoid repeated imports/inserts. Full-suite runtime fell from 42.18s to 16.63s: `318 passed, 4 skipped in 16.63 seconds`. Latest targeted result: `46 passed in 2.77 seconds`. Elasticsearch counts match at 18,432 documents; alias-swap write blocking and swap remain. `test_apply_credit_after_refund` still returned `90.00` instead of `87.50` and needs resolution.
